serviceInterval: Condition-based maintenance; original-body guide lists cabin filter every 2 years, brake-fluid health check every 4 years and tyre rotation at 10,000 km or uneven wear.
serviceBasis: ESTIMATE: A$350/year planning midpoint (A$200–500). An Australian Tesla specialist advertises service from A$199; RACQ gives A$200–400 for a general EV inspection. Allow periodic filters/fluid checks across the years. This is a voluntary/condition-based maintenance budget, not a mandatory Tesla annual package; tyres and fault repairs are separate.
warrantyCautions: 2022–2025 cars originally had 4 years / 80,000 km basic cover. The 5-year unlimited-kilometre offer applies to deliveries from 1 January 2026; confirm the original contract and start date.
HV battery / drive unit: RWD 8 years / 160,000 km; Long Range 8 years / 192,000 km, with 70% capacity retention. Warranty balance follows the transferred vehicle.
The extra used-car warranty applies to certified cars purchased directly from Tesla, not every used Model Y. Manufacturing warranty and accident insurance address different events.

Full replacement planning total assumes parts, labour and GST; not a hard ceiling or a priced repair offer.
risks.warranty: Check remaining HV warranty, fault diagnosis, battery health and damage exclusions.

risks.title: VIN-specific steering-assist software recall
risks.detail: REC-006300 covers selected 2022–2023 VINs. Ask for the applicable campaign/software status; vehicles on software 2023.38.4 or later are not subject to this action.
risks.priceBasis: Official VIN-applicable over-the-air recall remedy: A$0 planning allowance. This is software rectification, not a future paid steering-rack replacement.
risks.warranty: An official recall is separate from ordinary warranty expiry.

risks.title: Air-conditioning / thermal-system diagnosis
risks.detail: The compressor also helps cool the battery. Test cooling and request diagnosis for warnings or poor operation; this is an inspection priority, not a claimed failure rate.
risks.priceBasis: ESTIMATE: model-specific quote unavailable; based on a Queensland repairer’s general A$1,000–2,500 installed compressor guidance, widened for an EV heat-pump/thermal system. Assumes parts, labour, refrigerant and GST; diagnosis, contamination or additional valves can exceed it.
risks.warranty: Improper third-party repair damage is excluded; non-warranty servicing may use an independent provider.

risks.title: Original Model Y front upper control-arm pair — supplier offer
risks.detail: A specific aftermarket suspension replacement example, not a failure prediction. Confirm exact VIN and part fitment; do not assume Juniper compatibility. Other providers, OEM parts or a narrower repair can cost less.
risks.priceBasis: Whiteline Australia WA533 displayed offer checked 18 October 2026: A$1,208 parts plus A$475 fitting, A$120 alignment and A$20 consumables = A$1,823 installed, GST included. Reconfirm the current fitted offer and workshop availability; an older category crawl had a different parts price.
risks.warranty: Manufacturing defects may be covered by remaining vehicle warranty; normal wear, external damage and chosen upgrades are separate. Diagnose before buying parts.

energyEstimate.basis: ESTIMATE, battery-side kWh/100km: family planning midpoint 18, range 14–22. The original RWD road test reports 15.9 with an unverified measurement boundary; treat that as an approximate starting observation and allow mixed variants, air-conditioning and family loads. This is not measured wall energy or a Juniper/LR homologation claim. Add the calculator’s charging-loss assumption once.

serviceInterval: Current Australian EV guidance: 12 months / 20,000 km, whichever comes first; confirm the original vehicle or EVO schedule.
serviceBasis: ESTIMATE: A$350/year midpoint (A$250–450). Same-model historical reference: RACQ's2024 new-to-five-year study at15,000km/year budgets A$26.32/month servicing for both Standard and Extended Range (A$315.84/year). Current minor-service bookings are A$165–214 incl.GST; obtain the actual VIN's alternating major-service schedule and current price. This replaces the less-specific Dolphin service-price proxy. EVO is a different powertrain/schedule and remains unquoted. Excludes tyres and fault repairs.
warrantyCautions: Current handbook: vehicle 6 years / 150,000 km; power battery and drive unit 8 years / 160,000 km. Confirm the updated terms against the VIN and first-registration date.
The April 2025 warranty simplification was reported as backdated to Australian deliveries from August 2022; do not use the original short infotainment/suspension carve-outs as current cover.
Battery retention threshold is 70%; an eligible remedy may use a repaired, new, reconditioned or remanufactured unit. Normal wear, impact and flood damage are excluded.

risks.title: 2022 child-restraint compliance recall
risks.detail: REC-005579 affects selected 2022 Standard / Extended VINs. Verify rear-centre anchorage and airbag rectification before using the centre position.
risks.priceBasis: Official VIN-applicable inspection / rectification is free; this is not a later collision-repair allowance.
risks.warranty: Recall eligibility is checked by VIN.

energyEstimate.basis: ESTIMATE, battery-side kWh/100km: 18 midpoint, range 15–21. Published nominal pack / WLTP range gives about 14.4–14.7 across 49.92/345, 60.48/420 and EVO 74.88/510; allow roughly 20–25% at the midpoint for gross/usable uncertainty, air-conditioning, load and mixed real driving. This ratio is a budgeting proxy, not measured efficiency. Add charging losses once.

GST (A$289/year); allow variation for pay-as-you-go and ageing. A new plan needs a car under 11 months / 15,000 km before scheduled servicing; existing plans transfer. Excludes tyres and repairs.

Pre-MY2027 HV capacity cover is 7 years / 150,000 km to 70% retention. The MY2027 change to 8 years / 160,000 km does not automatically extend older cars.
A capacity remedy restores at least the threshold, not necessarily 100%. The 12V auxiliary battery has 2-year cover; normal wear and accident damage are separate.
